extractedText: Naval Air Station Oceana to conduct emergency response exerciseValenti GovantesUpdated Sun, July 12, 2026 at 4:02 PM UTC0VIRGINIA BEACH, Va. (WAVY) — Naval Air Station Oceana in Virginia Beach will conduct a large-scale emergency response exercise Tuesday, according to a post from the base on Facebook.The base will conduct the regularly scheduled exercise on July 14. The exercise is intended to prepare the installation and community partners to respond to mishaps and security incidents. It’s also not in response to any specific threat.People who are on or near the installation may see simulated smoke, hear sirens or view emergency vehicles near the base.AdvertisementFor more information, you can visit Naval Air Station Oceana’s webpage on Commander, Navy Region Mid-Atlantic’s website here.Download the WAVY News App to keep up with the latest news, weather and sports from WAVY-TV 10.
